review_requirements: During export, account for every native face exactly once across rigid surfaces and cover_tether_surface, preserving UVs and PBR. Confirm nonempty visible selections for all proposed moving parts and retain attached sight, handle, collars and feet under their declared owners. Record additions separately within the approved per-repair and total area budgets.

Using static joint transforms only, inspect visible attachment continuity at minimum, midpoint and maximum finite parameters for elevation, cover_swing, focus_slide and all three leg extensions. Confirm saddle support, rear sleeve overlap, collar/rail continuity and tether attachments. Use only approved bounded connectors under their named owners. This is construction inspection, not a physical endpoint or contact test.

Export azimuth and focus_rotation as hinges with limited=false and no joint range or parameters.limits. Keep preview coordinates unwrapped and accept values beyond 2*pi without imposing actuator angle bounds. Inspect representative static poses including 0, pi/2, pi and 2*pi, confirming actual native surface transforms and correct descendants; a full-turn return alone is insufficient evidence of visible binding.

Create the declared coarse cable discretization and dedicated native skin binding. Show a nonzero bounded parameter deformation that changes internal tether shape rather than moving it only as a rigid body. Keep the upper endpoint attached to optical_assembly and the lower endpoint attached to cover during cover and aiming transforms. Retain native appearance and identify this as parameter preview, with no gravity, load or recovery execution.

Save the interactive GLB, editable Blender source, MJCF and interactive metadata, then publish promptly. Expose the planned core controls and tether parameter; label missing secondary actions and deferred foot compliance. Set physics_status=not_tested and physics_attempts=0. Do not run physics.py, simulate, verify_integration, mj_step, physical trajectories or validation loops, and do not manufacture physical reports.
